title: Finite-interval page homology compatibility
statement: Let C be abelian and Y an EInt-indexed first-quadrant spectral object, with its standard E2 spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. For natural p and integer s>=2, let m_s be the composite from the (p,0) page-s term to H_Y^p(0,s-1): the canonical spectralSequencePageXIso to E^p(2-s,0,1,s-1), then iota-E to the opcycles of (0,1,s-1), then fromOpcycles to H_Y^p(0,s-1). For every r>=2, iCycles_(p,0) followed by m_r and the H-map extending (0,r-1) to (0,r) equals homologyPi_(p,0) followed by the standard page-r homology comparison and m_(r+1). This is a finite-interval equality, before the inverse comparison with H_Y^p(bottom,r-1) and before passage to H_Y^p(bottom,top).

source.place: SpectralSequence.lean: spectralSequence_iso, spectralSequenceHomologyData_left_i and spectralSequenceHomologyData_left_π; Page.lean: map_ιE; Cycles.lean: opcyclesMap_fromOpcycles

proof.text: Instantiate the page homology data with i0prime=2-(r+1), i0=2-r, i1=0, i2=1, i3=r-1 and i3prime=r+1-1, using the actual previous and next positions in the natural-number spectral-sequence shape. Rewrite spectralSequence_iso, cancel the page isomorphisms, and rewrite the cycles inclusion and homology projection by the left homology data. Their inclusion and quotient are the maps changing respectively the first and last interval endpoint.

Apply map_ιE to both maps. The opcycles map induced by changing the first endpoint is the identity; the other is threeδ₃Toδ₂prime from (0,1,r-1) to (0,1,r). Apply opcyclesMap_fromOpcycles with the H-map twoδ₂Toδ₁prime from (0,r-1) to (0,r). The resulting composites are identical. Mathlib homology data cover absent differentials at the boundary as well as interior positions.

theorem bottomPage_interval_compatibility
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (Y : SpectralObject C EInt) [Y.IsFirstQuadrant]
    (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    let m (s : ℤ) (hs : 2 ≤ s) :
        (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.page s hs).X (p, 0) ⟶
          (Y.H p).obj (mk₁ (homOfLE
            (show ((0 : ℤ) : EInt) ≤ (s - 1 : ℤ) by simp; omega))) :=
    (Y.spectralSequencePageXIso coreE₂CohomologicalNat s hs (p, 0)
      (2 - s : ℤ) (0 : ℤ) (1 : ℤ) (s - 1 : ℤ)
      (by simp; congr 1; omega) rfl (by simp) (by simp)
      (p - 1) p (p + 1) (by simp)).hom ≫
    Y.ιE (homOfLE (show ((2 - s : ℤ) : EInt) ≤ (0 : ℤ) by simp; omega))
      (homOfLE (show ((0 : ℤ) : EInt) ≤ (1 : ℤ) by simp))
      (homOfLE (show ((1 : ℤ) : EInt) ≤ (s - 1 : ℤ) by simp; omega))
      (p - 1) p (p + 1) ≫
    Y.fromOpcycles (homOfLE (show ((0 : ℤ) : EInt) ≤ (1 : ℤ) by simp))
      (homOfLE (show ((1 : ℤ) : EInt) ≤ (s - 1 : ℤ) by simp; omega))
      (homOfLE (show ((0 : ℤ) : EInt) ≤ (s - 1 : ℤ) by simp; omega))
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _) p
    (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.page r hr).iCycles (p, 0) ≫ m r hr ≫
        (Y.H p).map (twoδ₂Toδ₁' ((0 : ℤ) : EInt) (r - 1 : ℤ) (r + 1 - 1 : ℤ)
          (WithBotTop.coe_le_coe.2 (by omega))
          (WithBotTop.coe_le_coe.2 (by omega))) =
      (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.page r hr).homologyπ (p, 0) ≫
        (Y.E₂SpectralSequenceNat.iso r (r + 1) (p, 0) rfl hr).hom ≫
          m (r + 1) (by omega)
